name: bdk
description: Broneq Dev Kit - reusable dev workflows, skills, agents, and hooks for any project

plugins.name: bdk
plugins.description: Broneq Dev Kit - reusable dev workflows, skills, agents, and hooks for any project

plugins.name: git-identity
plugins.description: Bind a project to a GitHub account and a git commit identity. Every gh call and every commit in it then uses the right one - carried by the environment, not by a prompt a subagent can miss.

plugins.name: bdk-skill-kit
plugins.description: Deterministic checks and authoring guidance for Agent Skills and Claude Code subagents: the skill-check validator plus the skill-authoring and skill-check skills.

plugins.name: bdk-craft
plugins.description: Engineering craft skills that change what an agent does: test-driven development, debugging, refactoring, testing strategy and Mermaid diagrams. Works alone, without bdk.

plugins.name: bdk-explain
plugins.description: Explains code, a flow or a concept as one self-contained, interactive HTML page opened in your browser, without leaving files in git status. Works alone, without bdk.
